title: F4 Chp 11
question: MaahadJohor2023_Q18
explanation:
中文：自由落体只考虑重力作用，忽略阻碍运动的空气阻力。
English: Free fall involves gravity alone, with air resistance neglected.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Perak2023_Q18
explanation:
中文：相同时间内的各段纸带长度相等，表示移动距离相同，速度保持不变，因此选B匀速。
English: Equal tape lengths in equal time intervals show equal distances travelled and therefore uniform velocity, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Selangor2023_Q18
explanation:
中文：JK在100 m位置为水平线，位移不变，斜率为0，所以速度0 m/s，选B。
English: JK is horizontal at 100 m, so displacement is constant and slope zero; velocity is 0 m/s, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SelangorSet22023_Q18
explanation:
中文：返程从K的7分钟、100 m到L的11分钟、0 m，速度=(0−100)÷[(11−7)×60]=−0.4167≈−0.42 m/s，因此选D。负号表示向家的方向。
English: The return journey goes from K at 7 min and 100 m to L at 11 min and 0 m. Velocity = (0−100)/[(11−7)×60] = −0.4167 ≈ −0.42 m/s, giving D. The negative sign indicates motion towards home.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: TerengganuMPP32023_Q17
explanation:
中文：真空自由落体只受重力，物体具有相同重力加速度；空气中阻力会使实际下落加速度不同。A的“重力加速度不同”应理解为合力造成的下落加速度不同。
English: Free fall in a vacuum involves gravity alone and the same gravitational acceleration; air resistance can change actual falling acceleration. A's phrase “different gravitational acceleration” should mean different net falling acceleration.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: TerengganuMPP32023_Q18
explanation:
中文：惯性天平利用振动特性测量质量，不依赖物体重量，适用于太空微重力环境。
English: An inertial balance measures mass through oscillation rather than weight, making it suitable for microgravity in space.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: KedahTrial2023_Q19
explanation:
中文：位移时间图斜率表示速度；OP斜率50÷2=25 m/s且恒定，PQ为水平线、速度0，因此选B。
English: The slope of a displacement–time graph gives velocity; OP has constant slope 50/2 = 25 m/s, while horizontal PQ has zero velocity, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: KedahTrial2023_Q20
explanation:
中文：同速度下，较大质量有较大惯性，较难停下；B 的惯性较大，因此其质量比 A 大。
English: At the same speed, greater mass gives greater inertia and makes stopping harder; vehicle B therefore has greater mass than A.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: KelantanTrial2023_Q19
explanation:
中文：自由落体指物体只受重力作用，忽略空气阻力，不是同时受重力和空气阻力。
English: Free fall means motion under gravity alone, with air resistance neglected.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: KelantanTrial2023_Q20
explanation:
中文：50 Hz打点器每间隔0.02 s；30 cm横跨10个间隔，时间0.20 s，所以速度=30÷0.20=150 cm/s，选D。
English: At 50 Hz each interval is 0.02 s; 30 cm spans 10 intervals taking 0.20 s, so speed = 30/0.20 = 150 cm/s, giving D.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: NegeriSembilan2023_Q19
explanation:
中文：速度=距离÷时间=100÷20=5 m/s，因此真实第19题应选A。
English: Speed = distance ÷ time = 100 ÷ 20 = 5 m/s, so the actual Q19 gives A.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: NegeriSembilan2023_Q20
explanation:
中文：降落伞增加空气阻力，使物资较慢降落，降低撞击损坏的风险，因此真实第20题选B。
English: A parachute increases air resistance and slows the supplies' descent, reducing impact damage, so the actual Q20 gives B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Melaka2023_Q20
explanation:
中文：加速度 = (60 − 30) ÷ 20 = 1.5 m/s²。
English: Acceleration = (60 − 30)/20 = 1.5 m/s².

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Perak2023_Q19
explanation:
中文：M车在12至16秒的位移时间图为水平线，斜率为0，即速度为0，表示静止。
English: Car M's displacement–time graph is horizontal from 12 to 16 seconds; its slope and velocity are zero, so the car is at rest.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Perak2023_Q20
explanation:
中文：油轮质量很大，惯性也很大，倾向保持原来的运动状态，所以关掉引擎后仍继续前进。
English: A tanker has a large mass and therefore large inertia, tending to maintain its motion even after the engine is switched off.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SarawakSubisMiri2023_Q19
explanation:
中文：15秒时图线位于10 m/s的水平段，应选A。现有答案C为20 m/s，与图读数不符。
English: At 15 seconds the graph is on the horizontal section at 10 m/s, giving A. Existing C, 20 m/s, disagrees with the graph.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SarawakSubisMiri2023_Q20
explanation:
中文：真空中没有空气阻力，羽毛和硬币有相同重力加速度，同时落地，应选C。现有D说羽毛先落，不符合实验。
English: Without air resistance in a vacuum, the feather and coin have the same gravitational acceleration and land together, giving C. Existing D wrongly says the feather lands first.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Selangor2023_Q19
explanation:
中文：质量的国际单位制基本单位是千克kg；牛顿是力的单位。
English: The SI base unit of mass is the kilogram, kg; the newton measures force.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SelangorSet22023_Q19
explanation:
中文：质量是物体所含物质的量，与位置改变无关；重量则是重力大小，因此选B。
English: Mass is the quantity of matter in an object and does not depend on location; weight is the gravitational force, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: PahangTrial2023_Q21
explanation:
中文：位移为速度时间图的有符号面积：30×2+½×1×30−½×2×30=45 m，因此选C。
English: Displacement is the signed area under the velocity–time graph: 30 × 2 + ½ × 1 × 30 − ½ × 2 × 30 = 45 m, giving C.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: PahangTrial2023_Q22
explanation:
中文：其他书本具有惯性，倾向保持静止，所以迅速抽出一本书时其余书本来不及明显移动。
English: The other books have inertia and tend to remain at rest, so they move little when one book is pulled out quickly.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Melaka2023_Q21
explanation:
中文：硬币因惯性倾向保持静止，卡纸迅速抽走后，硬币在重力作用下落入杯中。
English: The coin tends to remain at rest through inertia; after the card is removed, gravity makes it fall into the glass.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: PutrajayaSet12023_Q21
explanation:
中文：负速度表示朝所定义正方向的反方向运动，不代表速度一定减小或正在减速，因此选B。
English: Negative velocity indicates motion opposite to the defined positive direction; it does not necessarily mean decreasing speed or deceleration, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: PutrajayaSet12023_Q22
explanation:
中文：速度=位移时间图斜率=(8−4)÷(5−3)=2 m/s，因此选B。
English: Velocity is the slope of the displacement–time graph: (8 − 4) ÷ (5 − 3) = 2 m/s, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: PutrajayaSet22023_Q21
explanation:
中文：巴士突然减速时，乘客身体因惯性仍倾向保持向前运动，所以向前倒。
English: When the bus suddenly slows, the passenger's body tends to continue moving forward because of inertia and falls forward.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: PutrajayaSet22023_Q22
explanation:
中文：20分钟=1200秒，加速度=(60−30)÷1200=0.025 m/s²，因此选A。
English: Twenty minutes is 1200 seconds; acceleration = (60 − 30) ÷ 1200 = 0.025 m/s², giving A.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SarawakSubisMiri2023_Q21
explanation:
中文：油轮质量大、惯性大，倾向维持原来运动，所以正确选项A；现有D势能不能解释持续运动。
English: The tanker's large mass gives large inertia, so it tends to maintain motion, giving A; existing D, potential energy, does not explain this behaviour.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SBP2023_Q22
explanation:
中文：速度时间图下的有符号面积等于位移，单位m/s×s=m，因此选B。
English: The signed area under a velocity–time graph is displacement, with units m/s × s = m, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Perlis2023_Q23
explanation:
中文：加速度=(7−0)÷(2−0)=3.5 m/s²，等于速度时间图前两秒的斜率，因此选B。
English: Acceleration = (7 − 0) ÷ (2 − 0) = 3.5 m/s², the slope of the graph over the first two seconds, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: Perlis2023_Q24
explanation:
中文：雨伞突然停止时，水滴由于惯性继续原来的运动而飞离伞面，所以选B。
English: When the umbrella stops suddenly, droplets continue their motion because of inertia and leave its surface, giving B.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SBP2023_Q23
explanation:
中文：真空中没有空气阻力，硬币与叶子以相同重力加速度下落，从相同高度同时释放会同时落地。
English: In a vacuum there is no air resistance; the coin and leaf have the same gravitational acceleration and land together when released from the same height.

title: F4 Chp 11
question: SBP2023_Q24
explanation:
中文：装满沙的桶质量较大，惯性较大，更难改变其运动状态，因此选A。
English: A bucket full of sand has greater mass and inertia, making its state of motion harder to change, giving A.
